name: COPA Cases - By Complainant or Subject

columns.name: LOG_NO
columns.description: A unique identifier for the case record. The log number can be used to link records in other datasets that contain a log number column.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_DATE
columns.description: The date that the complaint or notification was made to IPRA/COPA and the record was created.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT
columns.description: The jurisdictional assignment for the complaint case.

columns.name: CASE_TYPE
columns.description: Whether a case is a complaint, a notification, or miscellaneous.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the case investigation, as of the date the data were last published.

columns.name: CURRENT_CATEGORY
columns.description: The category of the primary allegation against the involved CPD member.

columns.name: FINDING_CODE
columns.description:
The overall current case finding, ranked by the following hierarchy: Sustained, Not Sustained, Unfounded, Exonerated, No Affidavit, and No Finding.

“Current_Finding” means that even after COPA has completed an investigation and made a recommended finding, the finding can change given post-COPA processes, including Police Department review, Police Board adjudication, and grievance and arbitration processes.

columns.name: POLICE_SHOOTING
columns.description: Whether or not the case is a police shooting.

columns.name: BEAT
columns.description: The CPD beat in which the incident occurred. If more than one beat was involved, the values are separated by the pipe (|) character.

columns.name: RACE_OF_COMPLAINANT
columns.description: The race or ethnicity of the complainant or subject.

columns.name: SEX_OF_COMPLAINANT
columns.description: The sex of the complainant or subject.

columns.name: AGE_OF_COMPLAINANT
columns.description: The age of the complainant or subject.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_HOUR
columns.description: The hour of the day component of COMPLAINT_DATE.

columns.name: COMPLAINT_DAY
columns.description: The day of the week component of COMPLAINT_DATE. Sunday=1
